info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Human Resource Management Workforce Training-spec
info.description: The Workforce Training Management API enables organizations to initiate and manage training programs for their workforce. By leveraging this API, businesses can create tailored training specifications that align with their human resource management strategies. Typical consumers of this API include HR departments and training coordinators looking to enhance employee skills and improve overall performance. This API streamlines the process of program creation, allowing for efficient management of workforce development initiatives.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and initiate workforce training programs designed to enhance employee skills and performance. Utilize this operation to effectively manage your workforce development strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new workforce training operation within the human resource management system. It contains all the necessary data required for creating a new training record.

201.description: Successfully created a new workforce training resource.
